import json,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
folder=Path('checkpoints/e3-rlpd-smoke-001/final')
state=json.loads((folder/'state.json').read_text())
with np.load(folder/'replay.npz') as data:
 assert data['reward'].size==4096
 assert np.array_equal(data['reward'],data['success'].astype(data['reward'].dtype))
 assert np.all(data['mask']==1)
 assert np.isfinite(data['env_obs']).all() and np.isfinite(data['next_env_obs']).all()
 assert np.isfinite(data['action']).all() and np.abs(data['action']).max()<=1
 counts={key:int(data[key].sum()) for key in ['terminated','truncated','success']}
with np.load('artifacts/e3-rlpd-smoke-001/first_boundary.npz') as data:
 assert np.array_equal(data['physical'],data['stored'])
 assert not np.array_equal(data['physical'],data['reset'])
assert state['critic_updates']==61440 and state['actor_updates']==3072
Path('artifacts/rlpd-smoke-audit-001/result.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(valid=True,real_transitions=4096,raw_labels=counts,physical_final_observation_stored=True,continuing_mask_all_one=True,new_environment_interactions=0),indent=2))
